clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge's Commons, Grand Mason Marblesten prepares a tribute to Sully Balloo. King Magni Bronzebeard commissioned the memorial for the dwarven soldier, who died in the Thandol Span tragedy, and Marblesten seeks stone worthy of the work.

Grand Mason Marblesten oversees civic projects and memorials in Ironforge's Commons. Dwarven stonemasons carve halls, pillars, and great effigies from the mountain, carrying on a tradition centuries old. Marblesten is among the city's foremost masters of the chisel, shaping stone to preserve the history of the Bronzebeard line.

King Magni commissioned Marblesten to build a memorial to Sully Balloo, a soldier who died in the Thandol Span tragedy. The memorial honors Balloo and his grieving widow. For a lasting tribute, Marblesten seeks Alterac Granite, one of the finest stones available, from Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad.
